* With Hide the Tako bubble on, tapping a caption (or its "more") no longer opens a sheet with "Discover more with Tako" and an "Ask Tako" box on some videos. The caption expands in place instead, the way it already did on videos without Tako content. Turn the switch off, or pause Hushfeed, and TikTok's sheet comes back (#162).
* A new switch, Only on the sides of the video, sits right under Long press in the Gestures section of Feed screen. Pick any Long press choice other than TikTok default, turn it on, and the choice runs only on the left and right thirds of the video. A press in the middle opens TikTok's own menu again, with Download, Not interested, Speed and the rest. It's off by default (#136).
* With Hide the comment bar on opened videos on, Share and its label no longer sit over the end of the progress bar and the time beside it. On a video with no music disc, Share is the lowest button on the right, and only the disc used to move up out of the bar's way. Now the whole row of buttons goes up when it needs to (#153).
* The LIVE chat auto-translate preset in Feature Gate Lab now says what else it needs. Its Translate comments button only shows up with a Japanese SIM too, so the preview asks you to turn on Override SIM details and pick Japan, NTT DOCOMO before you restart TikTok (#98).
* A recorded screen layout now lists a popup's own views even when the screen behind it is very busy, and it no longer spends its space on the next video waiting under the For You feed. Before, the export could run out of room before it reached a card on screen (#162).
* Hushfeed settings can now follow TikTok in Simplified Chinese. The complete first translation covers the settings pages, dialogs and runtime messages. Traditional Chinese stays in English until it has its own translation, and corrections to this first pass are welcome.
* Allow screenshots and Circle to Search now covers popups that TikTok builds outside an Activity window. A controlled Android 15 check of TikTok's own Compose popup showed black with the switch off, visible content with it on, and black again while Hushfeed was paused. Naturally served popups still depend on what TikTok enables for an account.
* Starting with the next release, Morphe Manager shows that release's whole change list even while it is the newest one. Before, Manager showed only the short bundle summary for the release on a phone, then showed its full list after another release came out. The published 0.74.0 index stays unchanged.
* The current TikTok 47.1.4 build passed strict Android 17 16 KB-page runtime checks. It cold-started twice and played more than one feed video with compatibility mode disabled on the 16 KB emulator. The target-37 audit also covers the reflection used by Block this commenter. Static alignment results remain separate and don't claim that every bundled 32-bit file is compatible.
* The Profile tab opens again on phones where it crashed or came up blank since 0.72.0. Two of Show follow status's hooks left a value typed two ways where their paths met, and some phones' Android refused the whole profile name class for it (#165, #140).
* A Dark or Black caption background keeps the rounded corners TikTok gives the caption. Hushfeed used to put a plain color in place of TikTok's rounded shape, so the corners came out square. The color now fills TikTok's own shape (#158).
* Save a profile picture on a long press works again. On TikTok 47.1.4 every hold on a profile picture said "Open the profile again and try once more", because Hushfeed looked for the profile under a name an older TikTok gave it. It now finds the profile the picture belongs to however TikTok names it, and still checks it against the @name on screen before saving (#160).
* With Hide search suggestions above comments on, comments no longer open with an empty white band above the comment count on some videos. On some accounts TikTok saves the banner's spot before it builds the banner, so hiding only the banner left its spot behind. The switch now answers TikTok's own "any suggestion here?" check, so no spot is saved, and the newer style of that banner goes too (#161).
* A comment's menu can now block the person who wrote it. Press and hold a comment and pick Block this commenter, and their comments leave the list right away, the way they do after a block from their profile. A banner names who you blocked and offers Undo. Turn on Block from a comment's menu in Hushfeed settings > Comments, under Blocking (#169).
* With See-through status bar on, every feed video now reaches up under the clock, not only the first one after TikTok starts. TikTok plays that first video in a surface it makes at launch, and later videos can play in another kind of player with no surface inside it, so they kept a black band above and below. That player grows now too. With Fit the video to the screen also on, Fit wins and the whole picture stays in view instead of being grown back over its sides. Fill the screen with the video already covers the screen, so it and See-through status bar don't undo each other (#164).
* Hide the unread badges on the bottom tabs also keeps down the bubble TikTok floats over Inbox when it opens, the one counting new likes, followers, comments and who's LIVE. It used to take only the red counts and dots off the tabs, so that bubble still came up every time (#170).
* Saving a big pick from a profile grid no longer gives up a few videos in with "the rest ran out of time". The whole save had two minutes for all its videos, so a pick of 50 always ran out. Each video now gets its own two minutes, and one that really stalls still stops the save (#27).
* Hide suggestions on the search page also hides the "You may like" list on accounts where TikTok 47.1.4 draws that list itself. On those accounts the list and its Refresh button stayed on the search page with the switch on, because none of the switch's hooks reached it. Your search history still shows, and turning the switch off brings the list back.

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* 4614 runtime tests and 954 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 135 patches applied to TikTok 47.1.4 with desktop CLI 1.18.1. Resource checks passed, and the attached release receipt records the exact bundle and its result.
* The attached bundle itself was patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 and installed over the last build on a Galaxy S22, which stayed signed in. Its Settings, progress bar and video overlay checks all passed there, 16 in all.
* Every patch went through a repeatable audit on a Galaxy S22 with TikTok 47.1.4. 349 checks passed and none failed. 17 more never got what they wait for on that account, like a contacts read or a floating promotion.
* The fixes from that audit were each seen working on the S22. Pages opened with a plain cut with Turn off screen transitions on, turning Default playback speed off counted from the next video, tiktok.com/t/ links copied in full, Hide suggested accounts cleared the Friends tab after its restart, the rewards gift box went with its switch, Copy username and Copy user ID showed on the Share profile sheet, and the search page lost its You may like list.
* Also on the S22, every feed video reached up under the clock with See-through status bar on (#164), comments opened without the white band (#161), Block this commenter showed in a comment's menu (#169), a profile picture saved on a long press (#160), Pick all saved 50 posts from a profile (#27), and a Black caption background kept its rounded corners (#158).
* With the comment bar hidden and only Like left on the right, the S22 showed the like count ending above the progress bar and the time (#145). With Bring back TikTok's translation on, See translation showed under a Spanish caption on the feed (#143).
* The Profile tab fix is covered by a test that runs Android's own type rules over every hook bridge, since the S22 never showed the crash itself (#165, #140).
* On an Android emulator, a press in the middle of a video opened TikTok's menu while a side press ran the Long press choice (#136), Share's count ended above the time on an opened video (#153), a caption tap expanded in place with Hide the Tako bubble on and opened the Tako sheet again with it off (#162), and Full-width progress bar reached both screen edges (#173).
* On an emulator set to Spanish, a full build kept TikTok in Spanish on a fresh install, after a force close and when installed over the build that had turned it English (#125).
* On a strict 16 KB page Android 17 emulator with compatibility mode off, a build from this source cold-started twice and played moving video. On Android 15, a TikTok popup showed up in screenshots with Allow screenshots and Circle to Search on and came out black with it off or with Hushfeed paused. With the phone set to Chinese (China), Hushfeed settings showed in Simplified Chinese.
